test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

None of them __are here__ at this moment.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**is here**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject "**none**" is singular, so it needs a singular verb.
 
• "**Are**" is a plural verb, so it is incorrect in this context.
 
• "**Is**" is the correct singular verb to use with "**none**".

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence:** *None of them is here at this moment. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**had her**e" is incorrect because "had" is past tense and doesn't make sense in the present moment.
 
• "**were here**" is incorrect because "were" is plural and doesn't agree with the singular subject "none".
 
• "**have here**" is incorrect because "have" is present tense and doesn't agree with the singular subject "none".
